note: PTF-CINCINNATI-FOUNDER-REVIEW-AND-APPLICATION-004 applied the founder-authorised block of 47 clean pet-friendly and 10 clean verified-no-pets candidates from Capture Pass 3, plus six of the eight exception rulings. Two rulings publish nothing by design: Extended Stay America Cincinnati Fairfield was RENAMED to Studio 6 Extended Stay Fairfield and its policy deferred to a clean recapture, and Great Wolf Lodge is HELD because the founder declined to accept a bare structured-data flag as a refusal. 74 published, 16 verified-no-pets, 6 out-of-current-category, 96 resolved, 160 unresolved. Unresolved is an absence of observation and never negative pet evidence.

final_state_meanings.OUT_OF_CURRENT_CATEGORY: A confirmed identity that is not lodging in our current category -- a restaurant, a bed-and-breakfast, a guesthouse. Not a refusal.
final_state_meanings.PUBLISHED_PET_FRIENDLY: Identity is confirmed pet-friendly with founder-approved Schema 1.2 facts, published to hotel_policy_facts_cincinnati-oh.json.
final_state_meanings.VERIFIED_NO_PETS: Identity's own first-party page states an explicit, property-specific refusal, founder-approved and recorded in the exclusion registry.
